name: @codegraph/core
description: codegraph core: canonical IR types, validator, sample generator, and shared analyzer plumbing. The IR module (`./ir`) is the single source of truth for the IR shape and is consumed by every other workspace package — viewer, indexers, adapters, diff, and the GitHub Action.

notes: The IR types canonical to v0.1 live in `src/ir/types.ts` and are re-exported from `src/ir/index.ts`. The `./ir` subpath export is the recommended import for downstream packages (e.g. `import type { IR } from '@codegraph/core/ir'`).
There is no separate `@codegraph/ir` workspace package in v0.1; consumers that previously planned to depend on `@codegraph/ir` should depend on `@codegraph/core` and import from `@codegraph/core/ir`.
